info.title: openconfig-vlan
info.description:
This module defines configuration and state variables for VLANs, in addition to VLAN parameters associated with interfaces

**Module:** `openconfig-vlan`
**Root nodes:** vlans
**Paths:** 10 | **Operations:** 22

GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE for config nodes, GET-only for state (config false) nodes.

**Includes augments from:** `cisco-xe-openconfig-vlan-ext`
